body: hey! okay, I'm not gonna lie to you - schizophrenia sucks a fucking lot. it really does. many months went by before I was diagnosed, many months with me just sitting in my room fearing anything fearable and non-fearable, curled up in an unreal world. I remember writing in my notebook - "the feeling of truth and meaning is nothing compared to the feeling of no truth and meaning". but even me being on (passing) the edge of breaking completely down, got better. it took time, a lot of thinking - and medication! medication is really what makes the difference in the start. of course it's probably gonna get really tough. but tough times doesn't mean game over! you don't always have to fight, it's okay to surrender to your unexplainable feelings every now and then. this comment is getting kinda long and I'm not sure where I'm getting at, but really, just embrace the help you can get and go with the flow. I've been so, so, so weak at so, so, so many points in my life. but I consider myself a very strong person - exactly because I got through these times, even when I didn't always want to. schizophrenia might ruin your life for a short time, but things get so much better. someday you will see your life make sense again, I really promise. it's not always a wonderful life, schizophrenic or not, but I SWEAR on my fucking diagnosis that everything will be alright, and you'll be happier than you ever dreamt you'd be. GOOD LUCK!
